name: Fallback
source: Fallback design system artifact, confirmed 16 Nov 2026

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Brand Black. The ground of every hero, icon and popover.

tokens.name: lavender-blush
tokens.usage: Brand Lavender Blush. Ink on black; light-mode ground.

tokens.name: frosted-blue
tokens.usage: Brand Frosted Blue. The one signal colour: front sheet, bloom, selection.

tokens.name: grey
tokens.usage: Brand Grey. Back sheets, hairlines, inactive icons.

tokens.name: burnt-tangerine
tokens.usage: Brand Burnt Tangerine. Alert UI only, never in the logo or marketing.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and window background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on bg.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised rows, notification cards.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and the wordmark on bg and surface.

tokens.name: text-muted

tokens.name: primary

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning pip and the offending version chip.

tokens.name: bloom-mid

tokens.name: bloom-edge
tokens.usage: Outer stop of the light bloom before it fades out.
